page-structure.evidence: Title is 'New Season' — generic, identifies no site name or page purpose (fails 2.4.2). No <h1> present (axe page-has-heading-one, best-practice). No <main> landmark (axe landmark-one-main, 1.3.1). The only real h2 is 'Let's get to know each other' (newsletter signup); two 'Popup heading' divs with role=heading/aria-level=2 are from the accessibility toolbar widget (visibility:hidden inside closed aria-modal dialogs — not real page headings). Landmark structure: header, nav, footer present; no main landmark. Page lacks heading hierarchy for its content sections.

grouping-and-reading-order.evidence: 33 <ul>/<ol> elements have list-style:none and no role='list'; these will lose list semantics in Safari+VoiceOver (1.3.1 — WebKit-specific). Notable: the main nav <ul> has 240 <li> items and no role='list'. The product grid, filter chips, footer link columns, social icon row, and breadcrumb are all affected. Tab walk order (header → search → nav → USP banner → promo banner → breadcrumb → carousel → filters → product grid) matches expected DOM/visual order — reading order is NOT REPRODUCED as a defect.

issues.evidence: Page title 'New Season' is non-descriptive — no site name or topic. Fails 2.4.2.
No <main> landmark. Content not contained in a main region. Axe landmark-one-main.
33 <ul>/<ol> elements use list-style:none without role='list' — VoiceOver (Safari) will strip list semantics. Includes the primary navigation (240 items), product grid, footer columns.

Product card link: aria-label='View product Basic Longline Fit Jorts' does not match visible text (which includes 'Add', 'boohooMAN', product name). Label-content-name-mismatch. Pattern repeated across all ~40 product card links (axe flagged 41 instances).
Color swatch buttons are 22×22px — below the 24px minimum target size. Axe target-size flags multiple instances across all product cards.
Search textbox: aria-labelledby='autocomplete-1355-label' points to non-existent element. Name falls back to placeholder only. 4.1.2 violation.
Search input labelled only by placeholder (aria-labelledby target absent). Placeholder disappears on input — no persistent label. 3.3.2.
Desktop search submit button (type=submit, class=hidden lg:flex) has no accessible name — no aria-label, no visible text, SVG with no title or aria-label. Axe button-name violation.

SALE nav link: red text rgb(255,0,0) on white background. Contrast ratio 4:1. At 16px bold (not large text by WCAG — needs ≥18.67px bold). AA threshold 4.5:1 not met. Axe color-contrast violation confirmed.

Footer currency/region selector <select> has no accessible name (no aria-label, no aria-labelledby, no title, no associated <label>). Axe select-name violation. Newsletter email input uses placeholder-only label ('Please enter your email address') with no id/aria-label — violates 3.3.2.

LOAD MORE button contains a nested <a> element inside — nested-interactive (axe). A <button> containing an <a> creates an invalid nesting that AT handles inconsistently. Axe nested-interactive violation.

The accessibility toolbar 'Accessibility' button (tabWalk stop [3], /html/body/div[2]/div[3]/button[1]) has outlineOrShadow=false and computed outline:none/box-shadow:none. noOutlineStops=1 in tabWalk confirms one stop has no visible focus indicator. This third-party widget button lacks a focus ring.
